items.q: What does an office cleanout in Port Perry actually cost?

items.q: Do you have a minimum for office cleanout services in Port Perry?
a: No minimum job size. A single office, a small commercial suite or an entire business property can be booked. The price is based on the actual material being removed.

items.q: Can you remove office furniture and cubicles during a business relocation?
a: Yes. We remove desks, chairs, cubicles, workstations, tables, filing cabinets, shelving, reception furniture and other unwanted office items. Workstations can be dismantled before removal when required.

items.q: Can you provide after-hours and weekend office cleanout services?
a: Yes. Evening and weekend appointments can be arranged when property access allows. This gives businesses more flexibility when they cannot have removal work happening during normal operating hours.

items.q: Can you remove computers, monitors and office electronics?
